verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents some configurable screening logic: you can configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores and create multiple screening configurations, choosing one per customer at screening time. This touches on risk-based logic, but the evidence never says this is a no-code UI, and the Starter plan's configurations cannot be customized at all. The automatic AI escalation of high-risk cases is fixed vendor behavior, not routing an ops lead can configure. Missing for 10: a no-code workflow or rule builder, conditional steps, configurable risk-based routing, country-specific requirement rules, template changes without an engineering deploy, and independent corroboration.
